description: CR-097 Stage 1 retrieval bank. Contextual before/after examples for rules that already exist but are not reliably applied. Append-only: never edit a shipped entry in place; supersede it (status=superseded) and add a new one. An entry needs 2+ distinct source_slugs, a real before/after from real drafted text, a why naming which digest rule already covered it, and a confirmed_by. Flipping few_shot_eligible to true is a human edit — nothing in the codebase may do it.
